ticket: 27 (BUG `iter_except` in recipes.py): body at `recipes.py:598-607` rewritten (all lines carry `  # fixed`): `try: result = first() if first is not None else func() / except exception: return / while True: try: yield result / except exception: return / result = func()`. The `try/except` around `yield result` is dead code (yield can't raise the caught exception from inside); effective logic: compute first value (first() or func()), return if it raised, then loop yielding result and refilling with func() (return if func() raised). Still NOT verified — `t IterExceptTests` not yet run (expect 5/5).
  ```
      try:  # fixed
          result = first() if first is not None else func()  # fixed
      except exception:  # fixed
          return  # fixed
      while True:  # fixed
          try:  # fixed
              yield result  # fixed
          except exception:  # fixed
              return  # fixed
          result = func()  # fixed
  ```
  NOTE: the `try/except` around `yield result` is dead code (yield can't raise the caught exception from inside); the logic is: compute first value (first() or func()), return if it raised, then loop yielding result and refilling with func() (return if func() raised). This matches the standard recipe. NOT yet verified — must run `t IterExceptTests` (expect 5/5).
- /app/FIXES.md current content (16 lines):
  - `10 | strictly_n | too_long callback was invoked with n - 1 instead of n + 1`
  - `11 | adjacent | boundary padding used True instead of False, marking edge items adjacent`
  - `12 | chunked_even | buffer threshold used islice step n instead of (n-1)**2+1, causing uneven chunk lengths`
  - `13 | only | raise used `too_long and ValueError(msg)` instead of `(too_long or ValueError)(msg)``
  - `14 | constrained_batches | batch flushed only when size AND count both reached, instead of either`

  - `19 | subslices | index range was len(seq) - 1 instead of len(seq) + 1, dropping most subslices`
  - `20 | grouper | strict mode check inverted, so 'strict' fell through to ignore (zip)`
  - `21 | mark_ends | final yield marked is_last as False instead of True`
  - `22 | rlocate | reversed-index formula off by 2 (used len - i + 1 instead of len - 1 - i)`
  - `23 | nth_combination | outer loop updated r + 1 instead of r - 1, so the loop never terminated`
  - `24 | intersperse | branch condition inverted (n != 1 instead of n == 1), swapping the fast and general paths`
  - `25 | divide | guard rejected n=1 (valid single-part division) via `n <= 1` instead of `n < 1``
  - `26 | nth_combination_with_replacement | total count used comb(n + r + 1, r) instead of comb(n + r - 1, r), so index bounds were wrong`
